title: Authoritative immutable semantic generation manifest and atomic current pointer
description:
Replace mutually inconsistent semantic writer/readiness/reader conventions with one authoritative immutable generation contract. Canonical layout: vector_index/current.json atomically names a generation and manifest digest; vector_index/generations/{generation-id}/manifest.json plus manifest artifacts are immutable; staging is never live. Fold legacy manifests and sidecar authority into SemanticGenerationManifestV1.

The manifest records creation/publication provenance; prior generation; requested/realized topology; a strong source snapshot with stable database UUID, source-change sequence, schema/content-selection/canonicalization/chunking/document-ID contracts, counts, ordered live-docset digest and content digest; exact model/input identities; and ROLE-SPECIFIC artifacts. VectorArtifact descriptors contain vector slots, live/tombstone counts, WAL absence, coverage, FSVI/storage identity and retained immutable-owner witness. AnnArtifact descriptors bind base owner/digest/docset/generation, algorithm/build parameters and sidecar digest; ANN must not inherit meaningless FSVI WAL fields.

Disk resolution is exhaustive and serializable: Missing, Building, InterruptedPublish, ReadyManifest, Corrupt, UnsupportedSchema, StaleSource, SourceUnknown, LegacyUnidentified and RecoverablePriorGeneration. A path-only health check or resolver without an expected source snapshot returns SourceUnknown, never Ready/fresh. A ready manifest has no mutable ready boolean. All consumers resolve only manifest-relative paths beneath the generation root; no filename/model-ID guesses.

FOUNDATIONAL INPUTS ONLY: consume exact landed FrankenSearch commits for canonical frozen identity, explicit artifact paths and immutable owned-byte FSVI inspection/search owner. Do not wait for terminal bd-jbfg or bd-p6z6. Later CASS children consume additional exact primitives as needed, and the terminal cross-repo receipt proves the integrated lifecycle.
design: SQLite/frankensqlite remains source of truth; semantic artifacts are derived immutable generations. Canonical manifest and pointer serialization is deterministic, versioned, domain-separated and hashed. Validation, parsing and exact/ANN search retain the same owned byte image for the full generation lease; no verified path is reopened for serving. Pointer publication uses unique temp, fsync, CAS/atomic rename and directory fsync. Readers validate and build complete context off-lock then atomically swap an Arc while old leases retain the prior generation. Legacy and future schemas map to typed recovery. Bounded logs never expose raw queries, documents, vectors, tokens, full paths, credentials or signed URLs.
acceptance_criteria: Unit/property tests cover deterministic serialization, every authoritative-field digest mutation, vector-versus-ANN descriptor invariants, duplicate/missing roles, traversal/symlink/alias defense, manifest/artifact hash-size-count mismatch, all exhaustive disk states, source-unknown behavior, legacy/future schemas and fast-only/quality-only/full/partial topology. Integration proves writer-produced generation fresh-process restart from pointer+manifest only, using the retained owned-byte search authority with no path reopen, conventional copies or model-name discovery. Replace/rename/symlink/hardlink/in-place mutation after validation cannot alter searched bytes. Fault tests cover temp write, fsync, CAS/rename and directory fsync with old-or-new visibility. Logs stay under 10,000 lines/8 MiB, contain first-party milestones, no dependency TRACE spam, and pass redaction. Evidence pins only the exact foundational FrankenSearch commits consumed here plus CASS/toolchain/binary/model/corpus/generation digests; terminal identity/provisioning integration is proven by later children and the cross-repo receipt, not required for this bead to close.
notes:
NORMATIVE OWNERSHIP CLARIFICATION (2026-07-26): this foundation owns a minimal, serializable disk-resolution vocabulary and pure resolver at the manifest/pointer boundary, not the full product readiness policy. Define exhaustive SemanticDiskResolutionV1 states for Missing, Building, ReadyManifest, Corrupt, UnsupportedSchema, StaleSource, SourceUnknown, LegacyUnidentified and other disk-only outcomes, plus stable disk reason and recovery-action codes. Legacy presence is diagnostic only and never discovered/served. Freeze canonical JSON and human-safe golden fixtures here; adding a state/field must break exhaustiveness/goldens. ds7uy.4 consumes this vocabulary with model/runtime/request/ANN/cache inputs to produce SemanticReadiness and the full user-facing RecoveryPlan/argv rendering. Therefore ds7uy.1 may not defer the disk resolver/vocabulary/goldens to .4, and .4 may not duplicate disk parsing or reason codes.

AUDIT-REQUIRED PLAN REFINEMENT (2026-07-26): preserve every existing semantic topology without compaction assumptions. A tier is an ordered, bounded shard set, not one unique role: each shard carries ordinal/range or coverage identity, FSVI digest/size/counts/docset binding and retained-owner witness; each optional ANN descriptor binds exactly one shard/base digest and carries ANN-only node/edge/build/binding evidence. ANN descriptors must not encode or compare FSVI vector-slot, tombstone or WAL fields. The manifest must represent explicit generation purpose/space kind, including HashControl as control/degraded evidence that can never attest semantic readiness. A successfully indexed empty source is a source-bound sealed EmptyCorpus generation/receipt, distinct from Missing and never forced through nonzero artifact invariants. Disk states also include InterruptedPublish and RecoverablePriorGeneration. Any resolver without an expected source snapshot returns SourceUnknown. The existing dirty max-four-artifact schema, shared Vector/ANN descriptor, rejection of HashControl, nonempty-only seal and path-only Ready resolution are explicit NO-SHIP conditions.

The crate then remained RED on unowned/pre-existing compile failures: src/storage/sqlite.rs:4088 and :4117: error[E0599]: no associated function or constant named 'open_existing_schema_only' found for struct 'fsqlite::Connection'; src/lib.rs:97197, :97203, :97217, :97269, and :99141: error[E0061] missing newly-required Duration arguments; src/lib.rs:97357: error[E0063] missing field 'budget' in initializer of SourcesDoctorOutput. comments.text: Owned implementation ready for parent diff review; bead intentionally remains in_progress and no commit/push was made. Added authoritative V1 immutable generation/current-pointer contract in src/search/semantic_manifest.rs and fresh-process public-API integration coverage in tests/semantic_generation_manifest.rs. Contract includes canonical/strict/size-bounded JSON, exact corpus/config/docset/content identities, model manifest/file/input hashes, full embedder id/revision/dimension, full CASS/frankensearch commit plus Cargo.lock/toolchain/features/profile/binary provenance, artifact format/path/hash/size/count/coverage/validation evidence, fast/quality/ANN topology validation, tombstone/WAL aggregates, fail-closed path confinement/symlink defense, immutable same-ID collision detection, atomic fsync+rename pointer selection, reason codes and rollback-aware recovery classes, bounded redacted milestones, and old-or-new fault checkpoints after temp write/file fsync/rename/directory fsync. Unit/property inventory: canonical order and every-field digest mutation; topology/missing/duplicate roles; count/evidence/ANN/path invariants; weak provenance/model identity; publish/idempotency/fresh load; missing/corrupt/future/stale resolution; manifest/artifact substitution; pointer crash checkpoints; unknown fields/missing/future manifest; arbitrary traversal/digest properties; symlink artifact/pointer escape. Integration test self-spawns a fresh process and proves resolution only via current.json plus manifest.json, with no conventional aliases; it enforces 10k-line/8MiB ceilings, milestone presence, no TRACE/tokenizers spam, and path/full-digest redaction. Final focused RCH retry reached all owned lib-test code with no owned diagnostic and stopped only on the separately recorded 8 unowned errors (2 FrankenSQLite open_existing_schema_only API errors plus 6 source-doctor Duration/budget errors), worker hz2 exit 101 after 316586ms. rustfmt --check and git diff --check pass on owned files. UBS reviewed: nonzero comes from its known secret-comparison heuristic misclassifying public schema/hash equality (including pre-existing lines) plus test-only panic inventories; no unsafe/Tokio/TODO/debug macros or actual secret/path issue found. Acceptance items that require writer migration/CAS leases/resume/rollback/GC, reader migration, readiness/RecoveryPlan goldens, legacy diagnosis, external gate commits, and CI artifact upload remain deliberately with ds7uy.2/.3/.4 and the umbrella; this foundation does not implement those downstream behaviors.
